description: Describe the architecture of the per-workspace metadata cache that the server consults on almost every request (object/field/index metadata, role permissions, webhook lists, etc.): how a cache entry kind is declared and populated, how multiple server pods keep their local copies consistent, what 'derived' cache entries are, and exactly what triggers invalidation after a schema or permission metadata change.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: Some keys are marked localDataOnly in @WorkspaceCache options (see commit d4ac6e752b).
Core-entity cache (engine/core-entity-cache) is a separate mechanism for core (non-workspace) entities.

source.verification: Read cited lines; confirm invalidation triggers by reading invalidateCache arguments in workspace-migration-runner.service.ts.
source.notes: UNVERIFIED claims in query phrasing: 'multiple pods' consistency is inferred from validateLocalHashAgainstRedisHash naming; auditor should read lines 563-615. Confounder: engine/workspace-cache-storage vs engine/workspace-cache.

evidence: commit d4ac6e752b (PR #22980) 'stop cross-pod recompute cascade on localDataOnly workspace cache keys'

notes: mapping note gt_path[9] (workspace-derived-cache-provider.service.ts:21) = WorkspaceDerivedCacheProvider (abstract class, key already correct)

cross-pod consistency verified: validateLocalHashAgainstRedisHash (:563) compares the local entry latestHash with Redis <key>:hash; mismatch -> fetch data from Redis or recompute (localDataOnlyKeys recompute). The signalling write is the private WorkspaceCacheService.invalidate (:~452) that stores a fresh random expectedHash (msetAndMdel) -- missing key; publish uses PUBLISH_WORKSPACE_CACHE_SCRIPT (constants file)

invalidation trigger chain is incomplete: after invalidateAndRecompute the runner calls WorkspaceMetadataVersionService.incrementMetadataVersion when schema metadata changed (runner.service.ts:108), which updates workspace.metadataVersion, WorkspaceCacheStorageService.setMetadataVersion and CoreEntityCacheService.invalidate("workspaceEntity") -- add incrementMetadataVersion

distractors are NOT irrelevant: CoreEntityCacheService.invalidate and WorkspaceCacheStorageService.setMetadataVersion are called on this path (workspace-metadata-version.service.ts:44-56); WorkspaceCacheStorageService is not "older" (still used by middleware.service.ts); CacheStorageService is the Redis layer WorkspaceCacheService itself uses (cacheStorage.mget). The directories exist (core-entity-cache/, workspace-cache-storage/): the mapping "not found" is a directory-vs-file artefact. Remove all three; if distractors are required use unrelated caches (e.g. record-filter or dataloaders)
the localDataOnly option (alt) exists: localDataOnlyKeys branch in validateLocalHashAgainstRedisHash
